title: What a coding-agent run preserved, and how far that actually reproduces it
description: Capturing the prompts feels like capturing the build, and it is not. Prompt text alone establishes that the instruction can be replayed; it says nothing about whether the same application comes back. So the packet records the three prompt forms and then names, on a ladder, exactly how far reproduction was demonstrated — with the evidence for that rung attached. A packet that captured prompts and claims BEHAVIOR_REPRODUCED is the failure this schema exists to make unrepresentable.

baseline.description: Reproduction starts from a repository state, not from a blank directory. Without this the prompts describe a change to something nobody can identify.

prompts.description: Three forms, and the original is immutable. The improved prompt is what you would send next time; it is not what happened, and a packet that keeps only the cleaned version has quietly rewritten its own history.

original.description: The exact instruction as given. Never corrected, never cleaned, never regenerated.

resolvedExecution.description: What was actually dispatched after binding scope, repository identity, authority, inputs, completion tests and runtime topology.

recommendedReplay.description: The cleaned prompt written after the run, carrying what the corrections taught. Optional, because a run that learned nothing should not invent a lesson.

humanInterventions.description: Corrections and reprompts. A run steered three times by a human and recorded as one clean prompt is not reproducible by that prompt.

environment.description: The agent, model and authority the run had. The same prompt under different tool permissions is a different run.

deterministic.description: Whether the generation process itself is deterministic. Only a deterministic process may claim BYTE_IDENTICAL; for everything else identical bytes are luck, not reproduction.

levelClaimed.description: PROMPT_REPLAYABLE: the exact prompt and context exist. BUILD_REPLAYABLE: the recorded workflow runs against the same baseline. BEHAVIOR_REPRODUCED: the required journeys and invariants pass. VISUAL_EQUIVALENT: required UI states match within the declared comparison rules. BYTE_IDENTICAL: generated files are identical, which only a deterministic process may claim.

evidence.description: What was observed at each rung. The rung claimed must appear here, and so must every rung beneath it: reproduction is a ladder, and a level cannot stand on an untested one below it.

freshWorktree.description: Whether the replay ran in a worktree created from baseline. A replay in the directory that already contains the result is not a replay.

notReproduced.description: What this packet does NOT establish. Required, and required to be non-empty at every level below BYTE_IDENTICAL, because a packet with no stated limit is one whose limit was never considered.

allOf.$comment: Only a deterministic process may claim identical bytes.

else.$comment: Everything short of byte-identical must say what it did not establish.
